topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of innate pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the innate immune system distinguishes self from non-self by detecting conserved microbial and damage patterns using germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Toll-like receptor recognition and downstream signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the ligand specificity, subcellular localization, and intracellular signaling cascades of Toll-like receptors.

topics.label: Cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptors and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss intracellular sensing pathways and the multi-protein inflammasome complexes that process pro-inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment, tissue trafficking, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sentinel cell activation directs immune cell migration into and out of tissues and can lead to severe systemic effects like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammation is terminated, how injured tissues are restored, and how persistent inflammation leads to chronic disease or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing housekeeping and announces the topic of the next lecture.
